lens: DOCK MATERIAL TRUTH — where does the glass-dock material paint?

root_glass_dock.note: root .glass-dock is a hollow positioning container — contributes NO material, NO pseudo-element paint

child_dock_plate.backdropFilter: blur(7px) saturate(1.3) brightness(1.14)  THE glass material
child_dock_plate.note: EVERY one of the 14 docks has directChildren [dock-plate, dock-controls]; the material is uniformly carried by .dock-plate

anomaly: 1 of 14 docks (i=4, a paused/static variant) has an OPAQUE plate (srgb 0.207 0.165 0.133, no alpha) with backdrop:none — no blur. Likely an intentional opaque/paused register, not a defect.
verdict: SUITE-ROT HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED (material on child .dock-plate, root .glass-dock transparent) — but DRIFT-EXPLAINED / NOT a paint defect: the material is alive and the trays render visibly glassy (see 09a-dock-overview-trays.png: collapsed pill, expanded home/search/bell/gear tray, media-transport pill all painted). Architectural indirection (class-name shell + plate carrier), not a dead material.
